name: octaweave_create_generation
description: Generate images. THIS SPENDS THE ORGANIZATION'S CREDITS, and a generation the provider's content policy blocks still costs them because the compute happened — never call it unprompted. ALWAYS pass a stable `idempotency_key` of your own: a retry with the same key returns the original generation instead of paying twice. Returns 202 with {id, status:'running', quoted_credits}; poll octaweave_get_generation until status leaves 'running'. Results land in the workspace drive. 402 payment_required means the org is out of credits.

workspace.description: Workspace slug or uuid. An API key is pinned to ONE workspace — call octaweave_whoami and use actor.workspace_id. A wrong workspace is a 403, not a 404.

negative_prompt.description: What to avoid, on models that support it.

num_images.description: How many to generate; must not exceed the model's max_images. Each one costs.

idempotency_key.description: A stable key of your own so a retry does not double-charge. Always set this.
